Sophisticated, simple single focal metaphor. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people, screenshots, watermarks, collage panels or decorative sparkles. A subtle retry loop around the second path conveys repeat delivery, one resulting record. No locks or security claims.
note: Original raster optimised to WebP for publication; illustration, not a software screenshot.
